title: Comparative Evaluation of Embedding Representations for Financial News Sentiment Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2512.13749v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Financial sentiment analysis enhances market understanding. However, standard Natural Language Processing (NLP) approaches encounter significant challenges when applied to small datasets. This study presents a comparative evaluation of embedding-based techniques for financial news sentiment classification in resource-constrained environments. Word2Vec, GloVe, and sentence transformer representations are evaluated in combination with gradient boosting on a manually labeled dataset of 349 financial news headlines. Experimental results identify a substantial gap between validation and test performance. Despite strong validation metrics, models underperform relative to trivial baselines. The analysis indicates that pretrained embeddings yield diminishing returns below a critical data sufficiency threshold. Small validation sets contribute to overfitting during model selection. translated_title: 金融新闻情感分析中嵌入表示的比较评估
translated_abstract: 金融情感分析有助于增强对市场的理解。然而，标准的自然语言处理（NLP）方法在应用于小数据集时会遇到重大挑战。本研究对资源受限环境下用于金融新闻情感分类的基于嵌入的技术进行了比较评估。在一个人工标注的包含349条金融新闻标题的数据集上，结合梯度提升方法对Word2Vec、GloVe和句子变换器表示进行了评估。实验结果发现验证性能与测试性能之间存在显著差距。尽管验证指标表现强劲，但模型的表现不及简单的基线方法。分析表明，当数据量低于临界的数据充分性阈值时，预训练嵌入的收益会递减。小型验证集会导致模型选择过程中出现过拟合。论文通过每周情感分析展示了实际应用。
tldr: 本研究在仅有349条金融新闻标题的小数据集上，比较评估了Word2Vec、GloVe和句子变换器嵌入结合梯度提升的情感分类效果，发现预训练嵌入在数据不足时收益递减，且小验证集易导致模型选择中的过拟合。
en_tdlr: This study comparatively evaluates Word2Vec, GloVe, and sentence transformer embeddings with gradient boosting on a small dataset of 349 financial news headlines, finding that pretrained embeddings yield diminishing returns below a critical data sufficiency threshold and small validation sets contribute to overfitting during model selection.
